events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite tune from the Burnage legend?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo single 'Imagine' was released on October 11, 1971, becoming a timeless anthem for peace.

angles.name: Imagine That
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to Imagine. Still as powerful today as it was in '71.

events.title: First iPod Unveiled
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket' and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped a game-changer that put a thousand songs in your pocket.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon, born October 9, 1940, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the genius of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: And Now For Something Completely Different
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Celebrating The Beatles' ambitious 'White Album' today. Which track from the legendary 1968 double LP is your go-to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: A True Champion
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true rock icon. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Celebrating a masterpiece today! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped 61 years ago, showcasing their incredible evolution. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's Death
events.blurb: Today marks the 46th anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who passed away on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Forever Imagine
angles.copy: On this day, we pause to remember John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His legacy of music, peace, and love endures.
